title: 第三十三章 再入仙门灵根论求月票第三十二章 立谈中死生同一诺千金重
lines: 第三十三章再入仙门，灵根论（求月票！）
【太平间】。
昏暗的世界中，一座简朴高台伫立，台上是一座翻开的巍峨书册，上面铭刻一道道古朴大气的篆文。
王平睁开了双眼。
呆愣良久后，他才从复活的余韵中清醒过来，随后生出了一个有些诱人的念头：要不立刻复活回去？
刚刚那一战，县衙捕快被他杀得减员了三分之一，四位外功圆满的老捕快全部阵亡，毫不客气地说，朝廷在龙兴县的统治根基已经坏了大半，这个时候自己复活杀回去，很大概率能杀徐秉正！
想到这里，王平顿时有些手痒。
不过很快，在看到已经孑然一身的自己后，他还是冷静了下来：“不行，所有兵器都在这一战毁了。”
玄螭弓，牛尾刀，护心镜，玲珑带，软甲.....和他一身武功相合的兵器全都在刚刚那一战报废，这些外物可不会因为他的复活而归来，因此哪怕当场复活，他的武功也会因为兵器损毁而暴跌。
“何况【域外天魔】还需要冷却。”
“徐秉正的修为本就高过我，我又没有容错率，要是不能以全盛姿态回归，一不小心就有可能翻车......”
思来想去，王平还是决定稳一手。
毕竟他可不是那种头铁的人，莽夫只是伪装，很多时候他的莽其实是很讲章法的，无脑莽那是找死。
“君子报仇，十年不晚。”
“还是先去仙门世界吧，等我修了仙，再学几门法术回来，直接降维打击这群粗鄙的武夫才是上策。”
不过在那之前.....
王平调转目光，带着几分期待地看向了眼前的巍峨书册，这次临死之前，他拿自己的尸体做了结算。
刚好【太平经】还有一道经卷的空位。
这次能刷出什么？
似乎是在响应王平的心念，很快，巍峨书册就亮起了微光，并且以肉眼可见的速度在书页上蔓延开。
空荡荡的页面上，王平很快就看到了自己生前的景象，令他意外的是，画面中出现较多的居然是苏夫人，从自己和苏夫人交谈，再到舍身闯城，再到最后苏夫人和一位高挑女子在桃林的谈话.....
“立谈中，死生同，一诺千金重。”
一时间，看得王平都有些许不好意思了，毕竟他能如此舍生忘死，归根结底还是因为可以复活重来。
如果不能，他自问没有舍生取义的决心。
“没想到【太平经】还能够显现出我死后的画面，看她这副模样，应该是京城苏家有人过来接应了。”
王平目光一转，看向苏夫人身后的高挑女子。
只是一眼望去，就让他灵识微痛。
很显然，这位高挑女子的实力绝不一般，上一个能让他灵识生出这种反应的还是全盛时期的徐秉正。
如此，他也能放下心来，这次不算白死。
下一秒，画面破碎，王平的意识重新回归现实，同时眼前的巍峨书册上，第三页的字迹也终于定格。
【卷三：一诺千金】
【为了生前的一句承诺，哪怕要舍弃性命也慨然而往，你的举动在某人心中留下了难以磨灭的印象。】
王平细细阅览着经卷的内容。
良久过后，他才轻揉眉心，眼底浮现出一抹喜色：“这道经卷.....效果和我事前想象的倒是截然不同。”
简而言之，就是贷款。
“【一诺千金】激活后，我可以在经卷上写下一道【承诺】，然后提前支取【承诺】完成之后的成果。”
“之后只要在时限内完成【承诺】，那提前支取来的成果就可以永久保留，反之，如果没能完成【承诺】，那经卷就反噬，不仅提前支取的成果会消失，经卷本身还会直接报废，无法再使用。”
“当然，也有例外。”
“那就是在立下【承诺】之后突然身亡，人死了，预取的成果也就消失了，【承诺】自然也会重置。”

Chapter 33: Re-entering the Immortal Sect, Theory of Spiritual Roots (please vote for me!)
【Morgue】.
In the dim world, a simple high platform stood. On the platform was a majestic open book, with simple and elegant seal scripts inscribed on it.
Wang Ping opened his eyes.
After being stunned for a long time, he finally woke up from the afterglow of resurrection, and then he had a somewhat tempting idea: How about being resurrected immediately?
In the battle just now, he killed one-third of the county government's police officers, and all four old police officers with perfect external skills were killed. To put it bluntly, most of the foundation of the imperial court's rule in Longxing County has been damaged. If he comes back from resurrection at this time, there is a high probability that he can kill Xu Bingzheng!
Thinking of this, Wang Ping suddenly felt itchy.
But soon, after seeing himself alone, he calmed down: "No, all the weapons were destroyed in this battle."
Xuan Chi's bow, oxtail knife, breast mirror, exquisite belt, soft armor...the weapons that matched his martial arts were all scrapped in that battle. These foreign objects would not come back because of his resurrection, so even if he was resurrected on the spot, his martial arts would plummet due to the damage of the weapons.
"Besides, the [Outer Territory Demon] still needs to cool down."
"Xu Bingzheng's cultivation level is already higher than mine, and I have no room for error. If I don't return in full glory, I might overturn if I'm not careful..."
After much thought, Wang Ping decided to play it safe.
After all, he is not the kind of person who is stubborn. He is just pretending to be reckless. Most of the time, his recklessness is actually very methodical. Being reckless without brains is seeking death.
"A gentleman's revenge is never too late."
"It's better to go to the Immortal World first. After I become an Immortal and learn a few spells before I come back, it would be the best way to directly reduce the dimension and attack these vulgar warriors."
But before that...
Wang Ping turned his gaze and looked at the majestic book in front of him with some expectation. Before he died this time, he used his body to make a settlement.
It just so happened that there was still a space for a scroll in the "Taiping Sutra".
What can be achieved this time?
As if responding to Wang Ping's thoughts, soon, the towering book lit up with a faint light, and spread across the pages at a speed visible to the naked eye.
On the empty page, Wang Ping quickly saw the scene of his life. To his surprise, the one who appeared more in the picture was Mrs. Su. From his conversation with Mrs. Su, to his risking his life to rush into the city, and finally to the conversation between Mrs. Su and a tall woman in the peach forest...
"During the negotiation, we will live and die together, and a promise is worth a thousand pieces of gold."
For a moment, Wang Ping felt a little embarrassed. After all, he was able to risk his life so much because he could be resurrected.
If not, he asks himself if he has the determination to sacrifice his life for righteousness.
"I didn't expect that the [Taiping Sutra] could also show the scene after my death. Judging from her appearance, someone from the Su family in the capital must have come to take care of me."
Wang Ping turned his eyes and looked at the tall woman behind Mrs. Su.
Just looking at it made his spiritual consciousness slightly painful.
Obviously, this tall woman's strength is by no means ordinary. The last person who could make his spiritual consciousness react like this was Xu Bingzheng in his prime.
In this way, he can rest assured that his death was not in vain.
The next second, the picture shattered, and Wang Ping's consciousness returned to reality. At the same time, the writing on the third page of the majestic book in front of him was finally frozen.
[Volume 3: A promise worth a thousand pieces of gold]
[For a promise you made during your lifetime, you will go there even if you have to give up your life. Your actions left an indelible impression on someone's heart. 】
Wang Ping read the contents of the scripture carefully.
After a long time, he gently rubbed his eyebrows, and a hint of joy appeared in his eyes: "The effect of this sutra scroll is completely different from what I imagined beforehand."
In short, it’s a loan.
"After [One Promise Thousand Gold] is activated, I can write a [Promise] on the scroll, and then withdraw the results of the [Promise] in advance."
"As long as the [promise] is completed within the time limit, the results withdrawn in advance can be retained forever. On the contrary, if the [promise] is not completed, the scroll will backfire. Not only will the results withdrawn in advance disappear, but the scroll itself will be directly scrapped and can no longer be used."
"Of course, there are exceptions."
"That is to die suddenly after making a [promise]. When the person dies, the prefetched results will disappear, and the [promise] will naturally be reset."
